idea-plugin.name: Jockey
idea-plugin.description:
Lets AI agents and scripts list, start, stop and restart the .NET projects of an open solution.
  • MCP tools on the IDE's built-in MCP server (dotnet_list_projects, dotnet_start_project, ...).
  • A local HTTP API at http://127.0.0.1:63342/api/jockey/.
Runs go through Rider run configurations, so they build first and show up in the Run tool window.
